definitions.title: Autonomous Differential Equations and Equilibrium Points
definitions.latex: \frac{dy}{dt} = f(y), \quad f(y_*) = 0 \implies y(t) = y_* \text{ is an equilibrium solution}
definitions.statement: An autonomous equation has rate of change depending only on y, not time t. Equilibrium points occur at the zeros of f(y).
conditions: f depends only on state variable y
definitions.explanation: Equilibrium points are classified on the phase line as stable (attractor), unstable (repeller), or semi-stable.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Phase line arrows point toward stable equilibria and away from unstable equilibria.
